desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulation 2015, we wish to inform you that, based on the recommendations of the Nomination & Remuneration Committee of the Company, the Board of Directors of the Company approved the appointment of Mr. Ashrith Kumar Kovver as a Branch Head - Hyderabad & Chennai and designated him as a Senior Management Personnel of the Company as defined under Regulation 16(1)(d) of the SEBI Listing Regulation, 2015, with effect from September 01, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations 2015, please find enclosed, the newspaper advertisement with respect to the notice of 20th Annual General Meeting of the Company scheduled to be held on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 11:30 A.M. IST through Video Conferencing (VC) / Other Audio Visual Means (OAVM), published in Free Press Journal and Navshakti.
